upworkBlurb: Power BI profit dashboard for an e-commerce store, built on the public Olist dataset (~99k orders). It calculates real net margin per product and per order after shipping and marketplace fees, and flags SKUs that sell at a loss. Includes a monthly P&L view, product ranking and drill-down to order level. Product cost is simulated and clearly labeled. Stack: Power BI, DAX, Power Query, SQL, Python. I can build the same for your Shopify, Amazon or WooCommerce data.
